title: Adaptive Multi-Agent Feature Selection for Personalized Fall Risk Prevention
abstract: arXiv:2608.18450v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Falls among older adults represent a major public health challenge driven by complex, time-varying interactions across multiple risk domains. Effective fall risk factor identification requires learning from heterogeneous longitudinal data while accounting for sparse and delayed fall-related outcome events. However, existing approaches are largely static and fail to adaptively model evolving, individualized risk factors across modalities and time. We propose PAFIR, a Personalized and Adaptive Feature selection framework for fall risk Identification and pRevention, which formulates adaptive feature selection as a reinforcement learning problem over longitudinal multimodal health data. translated_title: 自适应多智能体特征选择用于个性化跌倒风险预防
translated_abstract: 老年人跌倒是一个重大的公共卫生挑战，其由多个风险域之间复杂、随时间变化的交互作用驱动。有效的跌倒风险因素识别需要从异质性纵向数据中学习，同时考虑稀疏且延迟的跌倒相关结果事件。然而，现有方法大多是静态的，无法自适应地建模跨模态和时间演变的个性化风险因素。我们提出了PAFIR，一个用于跌倒风险识别与预防的个性化自适应特征选择框架，该框架将自适应特征选择表述为纵向多模态健康数据上的强化学习问题。PAFIR联合建模了相关评估变量之间的结构依赖性和可穿戴设备衍生的身体活动数据中的时间动态，并利用从稀疏跌倒事件中导出的奖励信号，在多次研究访视中学习自适应选择策略。
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于强化学习的个性化自适应特征选择框架PAFIR，能够动态建模多模态纵向健康数据，以应对稀疏延迟的跌倒事件，从而提升老年人跌倒风险识别的准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes PAFIR, a reinforcement learning-based personalized adaptive feature selection framework that dynamically models multimodal longitudinal health data to address sparse and delayed fall events, improving fall risk identification for older adults.
